owl:Class.rdfs:label: crosshead_2.231
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: extruder head fixed perpendicular to the axis of the extruder barrel.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: extensometer_2.1775
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: component of a tensile- or compression-testing machine which measures the change in the distance between the gauge marks on the test specimen.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: A polymer material
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: Polymeric materials used in plastics and adhesives (added from ISO 472 vocabulary pages).

owl:Class.rdfs:label: acrylic plastic
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: plastic based on polymers made with acrylic acid or a structural derivative of acrylic acid, or their copolymers with other monomers; the acrylic monomer(s) being in the greatest amount by mass.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: acrylonitrile-butadiene rubber
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: range of synthetic rubbers made by the copolymerization of buta-1,3-diene and acrylonitrile. NOTE Depending on their acrylonitrile content, these rubbers are oil- and solvent-resistant. Commonly abbreviated NBR.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: acrylonitrile-butadiene-styrene plastic
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: plastic, based on terpolymers and/or blends of polymers and copolymers, made with acrylonitrile, butadiene and styrene.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: acrylonitrile methyl methacrylate plastic
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: plastic based on copolymers of acrylonitrile and methyl methacrylate.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: addition polymer
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: polymer made by addition polymerization.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: activated sludge
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: mixture produced in the aerobic treatment of waste water by the growth of bacteria and other microorganisms in the presence of dissolved oxygen. NOTE It is used in the composting of plastics waste.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: activator
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: substance used in small proportions to increase the effectiveness of an accelerator or to promote a reaction.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: activation
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: provision or restoration of the bonding properties of a dried adhesive coat.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: test procedure
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: Procedural occurrents used to obtain test data (e.g. tensile tests, abrasion tests, ageing tests).

owl:Class.rdfs:label: accelerated-ageing test
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: short-term test designed to simulate the effects of longer-term service conditions.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: abrasion test
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: abrasion testing: progressive loss of material from the operating surface of a plastic material resulting from the cutting or scratching action of an abrasive wheel or abrasive paper.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: abrasive wheel
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: abrasion testing small grinding wheel or a roller faced with abrasive paper used as an abrading tool in abrasion tests.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: accuracy of the mean_2.2
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: closeness of agreement between the true value and the mean result which would be obtained by applying an experimental procedure a very large number of times. NOTE The smaller the systematic part of the experimental errors which affect the result, the more accurate is the procedure.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: adherence_2.11
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: be in a state of adherence.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: adherend_2.12
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: body that is, or is intended to be, held to another body.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: adherend failure_2.1669
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: failure of an adhesive bond in the body of an adherend.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: adhesion_2.1654
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: state in which two surfaces are held together by interfacial adhesive bonds. NOTE Adherence can be achieved with or without the use of an adhesive.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: adhesion failure_2.30
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: failure of an adhesive bond in such a way that the separation appears to be at the adhesive/adherend interface.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: adhesion promoter_2.1548
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: coupling agent: substance used in small proportions to increase the adhesion to specific substrates.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: adhesive coat_2.1623
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: adhesive layer applied to an adherend.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: adhesive film_2.1624
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: adhesive coat separated from the substrate after setting. NOTE Adhesive films are used for test purposes.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: adhesive line_2.32
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: glue line (deprecated) — space filled with adhesive between two parts to be bonded or in a bonded product.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: adhesive tape_2.1527
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: flexible backing or carrier coated with a pressure-sensitive, moistureable or heat-activatable adhesive.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: afterflame_2.33
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: persistence of glowing combustion after both removal of the ignition source and the cessation of any flaming.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: afterflame time_2.34
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: length of time for which an afterflame persists under specified conditions. NOTE It is expressed in seconds.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: afterglow_2.35
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: persistence of glowing combustion after both removal of the ignition source and the cessation of any flaming.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: afterglow time_2.169
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: length of time for which an afterglow persists under specified conditions. NOTE It is expressed in seconds.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: agglomerate_2.1677
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: shredded and/or granulated plastics material in the form of particles which cling together.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: air pressing_2.1632
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: application of pressure to an assembly by means of a flexible cover or bag inflated by compressed air.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: air-assist vacuum thermoforming_2.237
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: vacuum thermoforming process in which partial preforming of a heated sheet is accomplished by air pressure before vacuum pulldown.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: air-slip vacuum thermoforming_2.238
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: vacuum thermoforming process in which a male mould is enclosed in a box, providing an air cushion to keep the advancing mould from contacting a heated sheet until the end of its travel, at which point vacuum is applied to destroy the air cushion and pull the sheet against the mould.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: allyl polymer_2.41
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: polymer or resin made by polymerization of chemical compounds containing the allyl group.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: alternating copolymer_2.43
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: copolymer in the molecules of which two species of monomeric unit are distributed in alternating sequence.

owl:Class.rdf:label: amino resin_2.47
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: resin made by polycondensation of a compound containing amino groups, such as urea or melamine, with an aldehyde, such as formaldehyde, or an aldehyde-yielding material. NOTE Urea-formaldehyde and melamine-formaldehyde resins are mainly of significance in the adhesive field.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: amorphous_2.50
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: non-crystalline, or devoid of crystalline structure.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: amorphous regions_2.409
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: regions within a polymeric material that, on the basis of X-ray diffraction or other suitable techniques, do not show any evidence of crystalline structure.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: anaerobic adhesive_2.51
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: adhesive that cures in the absence of oxygen, curing being inhibited by the presence of oxygen and catalysed by metallic ions.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: angle-head_2.52
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: extruder head fixed at an angle to the axis of the extruder barrel.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: aniline-formaldehyde resin_2.54
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: resin made by polycondensation of aniline with formaldehyde.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: annealing_2.1051
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: heat treatment of plastic materials to reduce stress concentrations.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: antiblocking agent_2.55
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: substance incorporated in or applied to films to prevent them sticking together during manufacture, storage or use.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: antioxidant_2.56
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: substance used to retard deterioration caused by oxidation.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: apparent density_2.58
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: mass divided by the volume of a sample of material, including both permeable and impermeable voids normally present in the material.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: application time_2.1648
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: time interval required for spreading an adhesive on the surfaces specified to be coated.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: applicator roller_2.1092
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: roller that transfers a controlled amount of adhesive to a surface.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: apprentice installer_2.1716
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: polyurethane foam spraying: individual who applies polyurethane spray foam on the job site, under direct supervision of a polyurethane spray installer.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: arc resistance_2.1720
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: ability of an electrically insulating material to resist, under specified conditions, the influence of an electric arc along its surface.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: area burning rate_2.60
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: area burned per unit time under specified conditions. NOTE It is expressed in square metres per second.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: assembly_2.1272
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: unit or structure composed of a combination of materials or products, or both.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: A-stage_2.66
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: early stage in the preparation of certain thermosetting resins, in which the material is still soluble in certain liquids and still fusible.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: atactic polymer_2.68
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: polymer in which the molecules of which have equal numbers of the possible configurational base units in a random sequence distribution.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: autothermal extrusion_2.70
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: method of extrusion in which the sole source of the heat is the conversion of the drive energy through viscous resistance of the plastic mass in the extruder.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: average molecular mass_2.1720
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: average of molecular mass values as defined by ISO 472: includes four types: number-average (M_n), mass-average (M_w), z-average (M_z) and viscosity-average (M_v).

owl:Class.rdfs:label: number-average molecular mass M_n_2.1720
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: number-average molecular mass M_n defined as Σ(N_i·M_i)/Σ(N_i) where N_i is the number of molecules of species i and M_i is the molecular mass of species i.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: mass-average molecular mass M_w_2.1720
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: mass-average molecular mass M_w defined as Σ(N_i·M_i^2)/Σ(N_i·M_i).

owl:Class.rdfs:label: z-average molecular mass M_z_2.1720
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: z-average molecular mass M_z defined as Σ(N_i·M_i^3)/Σ(N_i·M_i^2).

owl:Class.rdfs:label: viscosity-average molecular mass M_v_2.1720
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: viscosity-average molecular mass M_v defined by the Mark-Houwink-Sakurada relation: [η] = K·M^a, and M_v = (Σ(N_i·M_i^{1+a})/Σ(N_i·M_i))^{1/a} where a is the exponent of the relation.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: back draft_2.14
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: regular polymer: the molecules of which have equal numbers of the possible configurational base units in a random sequence distribution. (Note: term appears in context of mould geometry variants such as back draft/back taper).

owl:Class.rdfs:label: backing plate_2.15
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: support plate: mould plate that supports the cavity block, guide pins, etc.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: baffle_2.16
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: mould plug or other device fitted in a steam or water channel to divert the melt flow and direct it to a required path.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: bag moulding_2.17
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: process of moulding reinforced plastics in which consolidation of material placed over or in a rigid mould is accomplished by application of uniform pressure through a flexible membrane, for example by a vacuum bag.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: baling_2.1678
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: process in which plastics waste is compacted and secured as a bundle to facilitate handling, storage and transportation.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: ball indentation hardness_2.486
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: quotient of the load on a ball indenter and the surface area of the impression caused by the ball indenter after a specified time of load application. Expressed in newtons per square millimetre.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: bar mould_2.18
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: multi-impression mould in which the impressions are arranged in rows on separate bars which can be removed individually.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: barrel_2.19
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: tube of steel that forms the housing around extruder screws, injection screws or injection plungers.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: batch_2.1679
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: quantity of material regarded as a single unit, and having a unique reference. Note: 'Batch' is primarily a processing term.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: draw-down ratio_2.303
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: the ratio of the thickness of the die opening to the final thickness of the product.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: draw_2.304
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: process of stretching a thermoplastic sheet, rod or filament to reduce its cross-sectional area and/or improve some of its physical properties by orientation.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: dry blend_2.305
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: free-flowing mixture prepared without fluxing or addition of solvent.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: dry-as-moulded (DAM) state_2.1763
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: state of a moulding, such as a test specimen, which has been placed in a moisture-proof container immediately after moulding.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: dry patch_2.306
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: <reinforced plastics> area where the reinforcement has not been wetted sufficiently with resin.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: dry strength_2.307
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: strength of an adhesive bond dried under specified conditions.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: dry tack_2.308
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: property of certain adhesives to adhere to themselves when apparently dry. NOTE "Apparently dry" means that the adhesive coat is dry to the touch due to the evaporation of sufficient amounts of the volatile constituents.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: external plasticizer_2.353
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: plasticizer added as an additive in a plastic compound (as opposed to an internal plasticizer chemically bound in the polymer).

owl:Class.rdfs:label: extruder head_2.354
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: part of an extruder situated between the barrel and the die. NOTE In some cases the head may be part of the die.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: extruder screw_2.355
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: shaft with one or more helical ribs, often divided into different zones, with different depths of the channel between the ribs and sometimes different pitch, usually having a cylindrical part at one end and a curved or pointed surface at the other, designed to drive the plastic mass along the surrounding barrel.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: extrusion_2.356
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: process whereby heated or unheated plastic forced through a shaping orifice becomes one continuously formed piece.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: extrusion coating_2.357
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: process in which a molten plastic is extruded continuously on to a moving substrate.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: exudation_2.358
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: migration of liquid constituents to the surface.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: bleed-out_2.358
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: migration of liquid constituents to the surface (deprecated synonym of exudation).

owl:Class.rdfs:label: sweat-out_2.358
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: migration of liquid constituents to the surface (deprecated synonym of exudation).

owl:Class.rdfs:label: failure_2.1463
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: capture testing: any break in the surface of the specimen which is visible to the naked eye.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: fatigue life_2.362
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: number of cycles to which a test specimen is subjected until failure occurs or the test is terminated. NOTE Fatigue life depends on the frequency and waveform of the applied stress, the magnitude of the applied stress and whether or not both compressive and tensile stresses occur within each cycle.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: fatigue strength_2.362
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: value of stress associated with fatigue life under specified conditions.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: feeding_2.366
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: supplying of plastic material to a processing machine.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: feedstock recycling_2.1690
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: conversion to monomer or production of new raw materials by changing the chemical structure of plastics waste through cracking, gasification or depolymerization, excluding energy recovery and incineration.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: filament winding_2.368
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: method of forming reinforced plastic products by winding resin-coated continuous strands of reinforcing material on to a mandrel or mould under controlled tension and in a predetermined pattern.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: filler_2.369
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: relatively inert solid material added to a plastic or to an adhesive to modify its strength, permanence, working properties or other qualities, or to lower costs.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: filler rod_2.370
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: rod of thermoplastic material used in hot-gas welding to provide a source of softened material to fill a welded joint.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: filler sheet_2.371
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: sheetless sheet of deformable or resilient material which, when placed between an assembly to be bonded and the pressure applicator or when distributed between a stack of assemblies, aids in providing uniform application of pressure over the area to be bonded.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: fillet_2.372
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: portion of an adhesive that fills the corner or angle formed where two adherends are joined. NOTE A fillet is usually formed by "squeeze-out" or by capillary action.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: film_2.373
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: thin planar product of arbitrarily limited maximum thickness, the thickness being very small compared to the length and width.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: film adhesive_2.374
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: film adhesives are usually caused to set by means of heat under pressure; they may be with or without a carrier.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: film blowing_2.375
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: process of making film by extruding a thermoplastic tube kept inflated continuously by internal gas pressure or during stretching and cooling.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: film casting_2.376
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: process of making film by distributing a fluid polymer, polymer dispersion or solution on a suitable substrate and then solidifying the polymeric material by suitable means.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: film extrusion_2.377
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: process of making film by extruding a molten thermoplastic through a die.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: textile glass_2.379
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: <textile glass> application of a coupling agent to glass textile products in order to improve the bond between the glass fibre surface and the matrix.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: fibre volume content_2.1061
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: ratio of fibre volume to total volume of composite.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: flame spray coating_2.389
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: coating process in which a powdered polymer is heated to fusing temperature in a cone of flame placed between the spray gun orifice and the substrate.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: flame spread_2.390
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: propagation of a fire front.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: flame spread rate_2.391
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: distance travelled by a fire front during its propagation divided by the time of travel, measured under specified conditions. NOTE It is expressed in metres per second.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: flame spread time_2.392
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: time taken by a fire front on a burning material to travel a specified distance on the surface, or to cover a specified surface area, under specified conditions. NOTE It is expressed in seconds.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: flame (noun)_2.385
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: zone of combustion in the gaseous phase, usually with emission of light.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: flame (verb)_2.386
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: intransitive: undergo combustion in the gaseous phase with emission of light.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: flameproof_2.1390
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: deprecated term, except in the context of electrical equipment for explosive atmospheres.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: flame-retardant treatment_2.1333
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: process whereby improved flame retardance is imparted to a material or product.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: flame-retarded_2.1334
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: treated with a flame retardant.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: flaming combustion_2.1335
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: combustion in the gaseous phase, usually with emission of light.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: flaming debris_2.1336
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: material separating from a burning item during a fire test and continuing to flame.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: flammability_2.393
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: ability of a material or product to burn with a flame under specified conditions.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: flammable_2.394
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: capable of flaming under specified conditions.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: flash_2.395
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: that portion of the charge which escapes from the moulding cavity during moulding.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: flash groove_2.396
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: groove in a mould designed to allow surplus material to escape during the moulding operation.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: flash line_2.397
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: raised line appearing on the surface of a moulding and formed at the junction of mould parts.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: flash mould_2.398
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: mould that is designed to allow excess charge to escape in the form of flash. NOTE The flash sustains part of the total applied pressure.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: flash point_2.1268
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: minimum temperature to which a material or a product must be heated for the vapours emitted to ignite momentarily in the presence of flame under specified conditions. NOTE 1 It is expressed in degrees Celsius. NOTE 2 Various standards, using different methods and equipment, exist for the determination of the flash point.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: flatwise_2.400
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: <laminates> perpendicular to the layers of the laminate.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: flatwise impact_2.1420
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: Charpy and Izod impact testing: impact on the broad longitudinal surface of the test specimen, in the direction parallel to the width of the specimen.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: flatwise position_2.1783
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: <determination of temperature of deflection under load> test specimen position in which the test load is applied at right angles to the thickness direction on the narrow longitudinal surface of the specimen.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: flexural strain_2.1407
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: <flexural testing> nominal fractional change in length of an element of the outer surface of the test specimen at mid-span in flexural testing. NOTE It is expressed as a dimensionless ratio or as a percentage.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: flexural strength_2.1404
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: maximum flexural stress sustained by the test specimen during a test. NOTE It is expressed in megapascals.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: flexural stress_2.1406
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: nominal flexural stress in a test specimen at mid-span. NOTE It is expressed in megapascals.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: flexural-creep modulus_2.1461
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: ratio of the flexural stress to the flexural-creep strain. NOTE It is expressed in megapascals.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: flexural-creep strain_2.1784
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: temperature-dependent strain at the surface of the test specimen produced by a stress at any given time during a creep test.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: flexural-strain increase_2.1408
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: specified increase in flexural strain that takes place during heating.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: floating platen_2.406
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: platen located between the main head and the press table in a multiplaten press and capable of being moved independently.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: flow line_2.408
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: visible line in a moulding in the direction of, and caused by, flow.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: flowability_2.1061
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: ability of a thermosetting moulding compound to flow and fill the cavity of a mould under given conditions.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: fluff_2.1692
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: recycling of plastics: filament-like regrind. NOTE Common usage of the term "fluff" also includes shredder residue fractions produced in the commercial recycling of durable goods such as automobiles.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: fluidized-bed coating_2.409
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: coating process in which either a part to be coated is preheated, dipped into a bed of powdered plastic particles kept in a state of flotation by an upward air current, and is usually subsequently heated to fuse the adhering particles, or a part to be coated which is at least slightly conductive electrically and earthed (grounded) is dipped onto an upward air current and which adhere to the part, and is subsequently heated to fuse the particles.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: fluoroplastic_2.410
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: plastic based on polymers made with monomers containing one or more atoms of fluorine, or copolymers of such monomers with other monomers, the fluoromonmer(s) being in the greatest amount by mass.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: foam in situ (verb)_2.412
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: form a foam, deposit and cure a cellular plastic mix at the site where it is used.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: foam-in-situ adhesive_2.413
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: adhesive designed to foam in situ, after application, in order to provide effective gap-filling properties.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: folded yarn_2.415
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: textile: general term designating yarn formed by twisting two or more single yarns in one folding operation.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: folded-chain crystal_2.414
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: polymer crystal consisting predominantly of chains that traverse the crystal repeatedly by folding as they emerge at its external surfaces.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: force_2.411
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: fracture toughness testing: applied load at the initiation of crack growth. NOTE It is expressed in newtons.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: force-deflection diagram_2.1785
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: instrumented Charpy impact and puncture testing: plot of impact force as ordinate against specimen deflection from the moment of impact as abscissa.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: force-time diagram_2.1786
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: instrumented Charpy impact and puncture testing: plot of impact force as ordinate against time from the moment of impact as abscissa.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: forming_2.416
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: process in which the shape of plastic pieces such as sheets, rods or tubes is changed to a desired configuration.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: fractionation_2.417
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: process by means of which macromolecular species differing in some characteristic (such as chemical composition, relative molecular mass, branching or stereoregularity) are separated from each other.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: fracture pattern_2.1668
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: <adhesives> visual appearance of the fracture surfaces produced by the rupture of an adhesive bond. NOTE The pattern can be classified with regard to the amount (or percentage) of adhesion or cohesion failure.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: frame_2.140
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: <pendulum impact-testing machine> that part of the machine carrying the pendulum bearings, the supports, the vice and/or clamps, the measurement instrument and the mechanism for holding and releasing the pendulum.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: friction welding_2.421
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: pin welding in which the surfaces to be united are softened by heat generated by friction prior to being joined.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: full fire development_2.1339
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: evolution of a fire to a state of full flaming of the combustible materials.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: fully developed fire_2.1340
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: state of total involvement of combustible materials in a fire.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: furan plastic_2.425
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: plastic based on furan resins.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: furan resin_2.426
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: resin obtained by thermosetting resins obtained by condensation of furfuryl alcohol or co-condensation of furfuryl alcohol or 2-furaldehyde with other compounds like formaldehyde, phenol, urea and/or acetone.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: gap_2.429
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: opening between two adjacent rolls or between two adjacent parts of a calender or other similar machine.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: gap filling adhesive_2.1523
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: adhesive designed to fill gaps between uneven surfaces.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: gas transmission rate_2.430
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: volume of gas which, under steady conditions, passes through unit area of a specimen in unit time under unit pressure difference and at constant temperature.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: gasification_2.1341
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: transformation of a solid and/or liquid material to a gaseous state.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: gasify_2.1342
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: transform a solid and/or liquid material into a gaseous state.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: gauge length_2.432
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: <tensile and compression testing> initial distance between the gauge marks on the central part of the test specimen. NOTE It is expressed in millimetres.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: gauge marks_2.433
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: <tensile and compression testing> marks made on the surface of the central part of the test specimen to indicate the point between which the change in separation is measured when determining the longitudinal strain (elongation) or compression.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: gel point_2.436
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: stage at which a liquid begins to exhibit pseudoelastic properties. NOTE This stage can conveniently be determined as the point of inflection of a viscosity-time plot.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: gel strength_2.437
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: measure, in arbitrary units, of the rigidity modulus of a gel prepared and matured under standard conditions. NOTE "Bloom strength" is a quantitative assessment of "gel strength", determined under standard conditions in a Bloom gelometer or electronic gel tester.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: gel temperature_2.1050
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: temperature at which a system no longer flows under shear stresses, but shows a tendency to tear.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: geometry calibration factor_2.1481
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: <fracture toughness testing> factor to correct the error due to the dimensions of the test specimen.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: glass transition_2.440
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: reversible transition occurring in an amorphous polymer or in amorphous regions of a partially crystalline polymer from (or to) a viscous or rubbery condition to (or from) a hard and relatively brittle one.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: glass transition temperature_2.441
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: approximate midpoint of the temperature range over which the glass transition takes place.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: glowing_2.1343
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: made luminous by heat.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: glowing combustion_2.444
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: combustion of a material in the solid phase without flame but with emission of light from the combustion zone (see "incandescence").

owl:Class.rdfs:label: granulator_2.449
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: machine for reducing large pieces of material or rejected moulded articles to a granular state.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: granule_2.450
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: small particle produced in various sizes and shapes in operations such as cutting, grinding, crushing, precipitation and polymerization. NOTE These operations also yield material in the form of powder; in some precipitation and polymerization processes material in the form of beads is produced.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: gravity length_2.1488
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: <pendulum impact-testing machine> distance between the axis of rotation of the pendulum and the centre of gravity of the pendulum. NOTE It is expressed in metres.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: green strength_2.1663
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: <adhesives> strength of a bond determined immediately after assembly.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: gross heat of combustion_2.1346
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: heat of combustion of a substance when the combustion is complete and any water produced has been entirely condensed under specified conditions.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: gum_2.1563
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: water-soluble vegetable resin; gums are dried exudations of plants or dried mucilaginous exudations and related vegetable products used as thickeners, stabilizers or adhesives (includes gum arabic, gum tragacanth and similar gums).

owl:Class.rdfs:label: handling strength_2.1664
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: <adhesives> level of strength which allows the removal of a recently bonded joint from the clamping or pressing device without damaging it.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: hardening agent_2.452
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: agent that promotes or regulates the curing reaction of resins or adhesives by taking part in the reaction.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: heat activation_2.1629
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: use of heat to provide or restore the bonding properties of a dried adhesive coat (also referred to as heat reactivation).

owl:Class.rdfs:label: heat flux_2.1640
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: amount of thermal energy emitted, transmitted or received per unit area and unit time. NOTE It is expressed in watts per square metre.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: heat release rate_2.1349
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: thermal energy released per unit time by an item during combustion under specified conditions. NOTE It is expressed in watts.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: heating-curve determination_2.460
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: technique in which the temperature of a substance is measured as a function of the programmed temperature while the substance is subjected to a controlled temperature programme in the heating mode.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: heat-sealing adhesive_2.1537
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: adhesive pre-applied to one or both adherends that is activated by the application of heat and forms a bond on cooling. NOTE Heat-sealing adhesives are commonly used in the packaging industry.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: hot-melt adhesive_2.469
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: adhesive that is applied in the molten state and forms a bond on cooling to a solid state.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: ignited_2.1355
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: state of an item undergoing combustion.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: ignition_2.477
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: initiation of combustion.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: ignition source_2.1356
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: source of energy that initiates combustion.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: ignition temperature_2.478
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: minimum temperature at which combustion can be initiated under specified test conditions. NOTE It is expressed in degrees Celsius.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: impact energy_2.1428
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: <Charpy and Izod impact testing> energy expended accelerating, deforming and breaking the test specimen during the deflection. NOTE It is expressed in joules.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: impact energy at break_2.1433
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: <Charpy and Izod impact testing> impact energy up to the deflection at break. NOTE It is expressed in joules.

owl:DatatypeProperty.rdfs:label: has impact energy at break value

owl:Class.rdfs:label: impact force_2.1427
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: <Charpy and Izod impact testing> force exerted by the striking edge on the test specimen in the direction of the impact. NOTE It is expressed in newtons.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: impact length_2.1490
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: <pendulum impact-testing machine> distance between the axis of rotation of the pendulum and the point of the striking edge at the centre of the specimen face. NOTE It is expressed in metres.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: impact strength_2.479
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: <Charpy and Izod impact testing> energy absorbed in breaking a specimen, under shock loading, referred to the cross-section of the specimen. NOTE The force required is usually measured in units of energy.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: impact velocity_2.1425
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: velocity of the striker relative to the test specimen supports at the moment of impact. NOTE It is expressed in metre per second.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: impact-failure height_2.1467
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: <puncture testing> pendulum drop height that will cause 50 % of the test specimens to fail. NOTE It is expressed in joules.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: impact-impulse mass_2.1468
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: puncture testing: falling mass that will cause 50 % of the test specimens to fail, for a given pendulum height. NOTE It is expressed in kilograms.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: instrumental peak_2.1426
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: <instrumented Charpy impact and puncture testing> first peak in a force-time or a force-deflection diagram, which arises from the inertia of the part of the test specimen accelerated after the first contact with the striker.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: indicative data_2.1286
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: <exposure testing> ratios of the mean values of indicative properties measured before and after exposure. NOTE They give a measure of the severity of the influence of an environment on a material for specific exposure conditions.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: indicative property_2.790
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: <exposure testing> property that has been selected to reveal the influence of an environment on a material through a comparison of measurements of the property before and after exposure.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: inherent viscosity_2.487
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: logarithmic viscosity number ratio of the mutual logarithm of the relative viscosity to the mass concentration of the polymer. NOTE See notes to reduced viscosity.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: inhibitor_2.488
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: substance used in small proportions to suppress a chemical reaction.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: initial crack length_2.1510
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: <crack propagation testing> length of the notch made in the test specimen. NOTE It is expressed in metres.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: initial stress_2.1452
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: tensile stress for unit area of the initial cross-section within the gauge length. NOTE It is expressed in megapascals.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: knitted fabric_2.515
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: <textile glass> planar or tubular structure made by the intermeshing of loops of glass yarn.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: large-scale test_2.1363
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: <fire testing> test, which cannot be carried out in a typical laboratory test chamber, performed on an item or items of large dimensions.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: latex_2.529
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: colloidal aqueous dispersion of a polymeric material.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: lay-up (noun)_2.530
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: <reinforced plastics> assembly of layers of resin-impregnated material ready for processing.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: lay up (verb)_2.531
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: <reinforced plastics> assemble layers of resin-impregnated material for processing.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: lethal concentration 50_2.1362
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: <fire testing> concentration of toxic gas or fire effluent statistically calculated from concentration-response data to cause the death of 50 % of test animals of a given species under specified conditions. NOTE It is expressed in grams per cubic metre.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: life cycle assessment_2.1803
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: compilation and evaluation of the inputs, outputs and potential environmental impacts of a product system throughout its life cycle.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: light (verb)_2.1365
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: initiate combustion. See also 'ignite'.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: lighted (adjective)_2.1367
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: state of an item after the appearance and during persistence of flame.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: longitudinal shear strength_2.1099
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: lap joint strength: force per unit surface area necessary to rupture an adhesive joint by means of stress applied parallel to the plane of the bond.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: mechanical adhesion_2.1622
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: adhesion between surfaces produced by an adhesive after setting due to interlocking with the asperities of the surfaces and to absorption of the adhesive by porous substrates during application.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: maximum open time_2.1650
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: maximum length of time after which an adhesive coat which has been applied to an adherend loses its bonding ability.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: poly(butylene terephthalate) PBT_2.729
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: poly(butylene terephthalate)

owl:Class.rdfs:label: poly(cyclohexylenedimethylene terephthalate) PCT_2.1829
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: polyester based on cyclohexanedimethanol and terephthalic acid (or one of its esters)

owl:Class.rdfs:label: poly(diallyl phthalate) PDAP_2.600
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: polymer of diallyl phthalate

owl:Class.rdfs:label: poly(ethylene naphthalate) PEN_2.1831
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: polyester based on ethylene glycol and 2,6-naphthalenedicarboxylic acid (or one of its esters)

owl:Class.rdfs:label: poly(ethylene oxide) PEOX_2.608
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: polymer of ethylene oxide

owl:Class.rdfs:label: poly(ethylene terephthalate) PET_2.610
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: polymer made by the polycondensation of ethylene glycol and terephthalic acid or dimethyl terephthalate

owl:Class.rdfs:label: poly(methyl methacrylate) PMMA_2.747
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: polymer of methyl methacrylate

owl:Class.rdfs:label: poly(phenylene sulfide) PPS_2.756
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: polymer in which the constitutional repeating unit is phenylene sulfide

owl:Class.rdfs:label: poly(phenylene sulfone) PPSU_2.757
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: polymer in which the constitutional repeating unit is phenylene sulfone

owl:Class.rdfs:label: poly(propylene oxide) PPOX_2.792
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: polymer of propylene oxide

owl:Class.rdfs:label: poly(trimethylene terephthalate) PTT_2.1832
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: polymer made by the polycondensation of trimethylene glycol and terephthalic acid or dimethyl terephthalate

owl:Class.rdfs:label: poly(vinyl chloride-vinyl acetate) PVC/PVAc_2.809
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: copolymer of vinyl chloride and vinyl acetate

owl:Class.rdfs:label: poly(vinyl fluoride) PVF_2.810
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: polymer of vinyl fluoride

owl:Class.rdfs:label: poly(vinyl pyrrolidone) PVP_2.815
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: polymer of N-vinyl-2-pyrrolidone

owl:Class.rdfs:label: poly(vinylidene chloride) PVDC_2.813
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: polymer of vinylidene chloride

owl:Class.rdfs:label: poly(vinylidene fluoride) PVDF_2.814
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: polymer of vinylidene fluoride

owl:Class.rdfs:label: polyacetal_2.717
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: polymer in which the repeated structural unit in the chain is of the acetal type

owl:Class.rdfs:label: polyacrylonitrile PAN_2.721
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: polymer of acrylonitrile

owl:Class.rdfs:label: polyallyl plastic_2.723
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: plastic based on allyl polymers

owl:Class.rdfs:label: poly(aryletherketone) PAEK_2.726
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: polymer in which aryl groups are connected by one or more ether linkages and by one or more ketone linkages

owl:Class.rdfs:label: polybutylene PB_2.727
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: polymer of butene

owl:Class.rdfs:label: polycarbonate PC_2.730
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: polymer in which the repeated structural unit in the chain is of the carbonate type

owl:Class.rdfs:label: polychlorofluorocarbon plastic_2.732
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: plastic based on polymers with monomers composed of chlorine, fluorine and carbon only

owl:Class.rdfs:label: polychlorofluorohydrocarbon plastic_2.733
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: plastic based on polymers made with monomers composed of chlorine, fluorine, hydrogen and carbon only

owl:Class.rdfs:label: polychlorotrifluoroethylene PCTFE_2.734
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: polymer of chlorotrifluoroethylene

owl:Class.rdfs:label: polycycloolefin_2.1834
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: polymer or polymer which has an alicyclic group (cycloolefins)

owl:Class.rdfs:label: polyelectrolyte_2.601
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: macromolecule with a large number of ionic groups

owl:Class.rdfs:label: polyether_2.604
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: polymer in which the repeated structural unit in the chain is of the ether type

owl:Class.rdfs:label: polyfluorocarbon plastic_2.735
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: plastic based on polymers made with monomers composed of fluorine and carbon only

owl:Class.rdfs:label: polyfluorohydrocarbon plastic_2.736
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: plastic based on polymers made with monomers composed of fluorine, hydrogen and carbon only

owl:Class.rdfs:label: polyhalocarbon plastic_2.737
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: plastic based on polymers from monomers composed only of carbon and a halogen or halogens

owl:Class.rdfs:label: hydrocarbon plastic_2.738
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: plastic based on polymers made with monomers composed of carbon and hydrogen only

owl:Class.rdfs:label: polyisocyanurate plastic_2.740
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: plastic based on polymers in which trimerization of isocyanates incorporates six-membered isocyanurate ring groups in a chain

owl:Class.rdfs:label: polymer-rich phase_2.746
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: concentrated phase of a two-phase equilibrium system, consisting of a polymer and low-molecular-mass material, in which the polymer concentration is higher

owl:Class.rdfs:label: polymer-poor phase_2.744
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: dilute phase of a two-phase equilibrium system consisting of a polymer and low-molecular-mass material, in which the polymer concentration is lower (term "sol phase" discouraged)

owl:Class.rdfs:label: polymethacrylate_2.1579
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: polymer or copolymer in which at least one constitutional unit is derived from methacrylic acid, CH2 = C(CH3)-COOH, or one of its esters, CH2 = C(CH3)-COOR

owl:Class.rdfs:label: polypropylene copolymer_2.1380
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: polypropylene in which the CH2-CH- repeating units are partially replaced by ethylene and/or another α-olefin

owl:Class.rdfs:label: polypropylene random copolymer_2.1381
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: copolymer of polypropylene in which the repeating structural unit -CH2-CH- in the macromolecular chain is partially replaced randomly by ethylene and/or another α-olefin

owl:Class.rdfs:label: polysulphide_2.1588
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: polymer containing disulfide, -(S-S)-, linkages together with repeating polyether units and usually terminated by thiol or hydroxyl groups

owl:Class.rdfs:label: polysulfone PSU_2.1837
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: polymer in which the constitutional repeating unit is oxy-1,4-phenylensulfony1-1,4-phenylene-1,4-phenylene(dimethylmethylene)-1,4-phenylene

owl:Class.rdfs:label: polytetrafluoroethylene PTFE_2.796
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: polymer of tetrafluoroethylene

owl:Class.rdfs:label: polyurea_2.799
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: polymer produced by the reaction of a polyfunctional isocyanate with primary or secondary diamines

owl:Class.rdfs:label: polyvinylcarbazole PVK_2.806
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: polymer of vinylcarbazole

owl:Class.rdfs:label: porosity_2.817
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: property of a material that contains very fine continuous holes which allow the passage of gases, liquids and solids in through one surface and out at another surface. NOTE Not to be confused with permeability.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: positive mould_2.818
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: mould in which the total applied pressure rests only, and continuously, on the moulding and in which there is no provision for escape of excess moulding material

owl:Class.rdfs:label: post-consumer_2.1700
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: covering material, generated by the end-users of products, that has fulfilled its intended purpose or can no longer be used (including material returned from within the distribution chain)

owl:Class.rdfs:label: postforming_2.2820
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: process for forming into which a product is subjected after initial manufacture, often applied to cured or partially cured thermosetting plastics

owl:Class.rdfs:label: post-shrinkage_2.2821
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: shrinkage of a plastic product after moulding, during post-treatment, storage or use

owl:Class.rdfs:label: potential energy of pendulum_2.1492
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: <pendulum impact-testing machine> potential energy of the pendulum in its starting position, relative to its position at impact. NOTE It is expressed in joules.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: potting_2.2823
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: embedding process in which the mould remains attached to the resin-encased article

owl:Class.rdfs:label: powder moulding_2.2824
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: process of moulding in which a dry, fusible powder is caused to fuse into a uniform layer against a mould wall

owl:Class.rdfs:label: precision_2.2827
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: closeness of agreement between the results obtained by applying an experimental procedure several times under prescribed conditions.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: preconditioning_2.1838
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: <exposure testing> pre-incubation of an inoculum under the conditions of the subsequent test, in the absence of the chemical compound or organic matter under test, with the aim of improving the test by acclimatization of the microorganisms to the test conditions.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: pre-consumer_2.1701
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: post-industrial material diverted during a manufacturing process (this term excludes re-utilized material, such as rework, regrind or scrap)

owl:Class.rdfs:label: pre-exposure_2.1839
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: pre-exposure of plastics waste: pre-incubation of an inoculum in the presence of the chemical compound or organic matter under test, with the aim of enhancing the ability of the inoculum to biodegrade the test material by adaptation and/or selection of the microorganisms

owl:Class.rdfs:label: preform_2.2828
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: shaped mass of powdered, granular or fibrous moulding compound, or of a fibrous filler material with or without resin

owl:Class.rdfs:label: pre-impregnated fabric_2.1073
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: woven fabric that has been impregnated with a thermosetting or thermoplastic resin system

owl:Class.rdfs:label: premix_2.829
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: admixture of resin, reinforcement, fillers, etc. not in web or filamentous form, usually prepared by the moulder shortly before use

owl:Class.rdfs:label: prepolymer_2.831
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: polymer of degree of polymerization intermediate between that of the monomer or monomers and that of the final polymer

owl:Class.rdfs:label: press (verb)_2.1631
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: <adhesives> hold an adhesive joint under pressure in a press during setting of the adhesive

owl:Class.rdfs:label: pressing time_2.1075
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: period during a press cycle in which the mould is closed and the required pressure is reached

owl:Class.rdfs:label: pressure break_2.2832
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: defects in laminates: apparent break in one or more outer sheets of the paper, fabric or other base of a laminated plastic, visible through the surface layer of resin which covers it

owl:Class.rdfs:label: pressure reducing_2.2833
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: reducing the pressure on the land areas of a mould when the mould is closed

owl:Class.rdfs:label: pressure thermoforming_2.2835
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: thermoforming process in which air pressure is used to form a heated sheet against the mould surface

owl:Class.rdfs:label: pressure welding_2.2836
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: welding method depending essentially on using pressure and also applying heat, e.g. to produce thick plates or blocks from thermoplastic sheets

owl:Class.rdfs:label: pressure-sensitive adhesive_2.2834
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: <adhesive> in a dry state, is permanently tacky at room temperature and adheres readily to surfaces under light and brief pressure

owl:Class.rdfs:label: primary anaerobic biodegradation_2.1841
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: structural change (transformation) of a chemical compound by microorganisms, resulting in the loss of a specific property

owl:Class.rdfs:label: strain_2.1659
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: change, due to the application of a force, in the size of a body, referred to its original size.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: strain rate_2.1001
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: rate of change of strain with time; Strain rate = dε/dt. NOTE It is expressed in reciprocal seconds (1/s).

owl:Class.rdfs:label: strand_2.1002
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: string of parallel filaments produced simultaneously, slightly bonded and without intentional twist.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: streaming birefringence_2.1003
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: flow birefringence introduced by flow in liquids, solutions and dispersions of optically anisotropic, anisometric or deformable molecules or particles, attributable to a non-random orientation of the molecules or particles.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: stress amplitude_2.1055
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: alternate stress equal to half the algebraic difference between the maximum and minimum stresses in a cycle. NOTE It is expressed in megapascals.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: stress crack_2.1006
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: external or internal crack in a plastic caused by stresses which are less than the short-time mechanical strength of the plastic.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: stress intensity factor_2.1007
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: <fracture toughness testing> limiting value of the product of the stress perpendicular to the crack area at a distance, r, from the crack tip and of the square root of 2πr, as r tends to zero. NOTE It is expressed in pascal square root metres (Pa·m^1/2).

owl:Class.rdfs:label: stress intensity factor range_2.1505
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: <fatigue crack propagation testing> difference between the maximum and the minimum stress intensity factors in one test cycle.

owl:DatatypeProperty.rdfs:label: has stress intensity factor range value

owl:Class.rdfs:label: stress ratio_2.1114
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: algebraic ratio of the minimum stress to the maximum stress in one cycle.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: stress-strain hysteresis loop_2.775
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: <dynamic mechanical testing> stress expressed as a function of the strain in a viscoelastic material subjected to sinusoidal vibrations.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: stretch ratio_2.1171
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: <blow moulding> ratio of the length of the parison to the length of the cavity in which it is to be blown.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: strike-through_2.1675
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: presence of adhesive on the surface of a porous adherend, the adhesive having penetrated through the adherend from the bond line.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: stringing_2.1095
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: property of an adhesive that results in stringing or the formation of filaments or threads when previously bonded surfaces are separated.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: stripper plate_2.1119
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: part of a mould that makes possible a rapid ejection, e.g. the removal of bottle caps with threaded heads from the mould.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: stroke_2.1121
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: travel of the ram of a press.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: structural adhesive_2.1122
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: adhesive of proven reliability in structural engineering applications in which the bond can be stressed to a high proportion of its maximum failing load for long periods without failure.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: structural bond_2.1672
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: bond capable of sustaining in a structure a specified strength level under a combination of stresses for a specified period of time.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: substrate_2.118
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: object or semi-manufactured product (e.g. wire, extruded metallic section or plastic profile, sheet, film, paper, textile product, etc.) on which a coating or layer of another material is applied from the gas, liquid or plastic phase by coating, by laminating or generated by a chemical process.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: supported-film adhesive_2.1526
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: adhesive, supplied in sheet or film form, with an incorporated carrier that remains in the bond when the adhesive is applied and used.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: surface cleaning_2.1614
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: <adhesives> surface treatment to remove substances impairing adhesion from the surfaces to be bonded.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: surface flash_2.1281
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: <fire testing> 'burning behaviour' movement of transient flame over the surface of a material without ignition of its basic structure. See also 'surface burn'.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: surface preparation_2.1613
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: <adhesives> physical and/or chemical treatments applied to adherends to render them suitable (or more suitable) for bonding.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: surface resistivity_2.1311
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: quantity of the dc. electric field strength by the linear current density in the surface layer of a material. NOTE The surface resistivity of a material is equal to the surface resistance between two electrodes forming opposite sides of a square. The size of the square is immaterial.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: surface tension_2.1089
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: property of liquids arising from unbalanced molecular cohesive forces at or near the surface, as a result of which the surface tends to contract and has properties resembling those of a stretched elastic membrane.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: surface treatment_2.1133
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: prebond treatment (deprecated)

owl:Class.rdfs:label: surfacing mat_2.1134
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: thin compact sheet of bonded staple fibres or continuous filaments, used as the surface layer of composites. NOTE The fibres can be of glass or organic material.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: suspension_2.1135
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: heterogeneous system in which a solid is distributed as fine particles in a liquid.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: suspension polymerization_2.1136
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: polymerization in which the monomer is dispersed as fine droplets in water or another suitable inert non-solvent.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: swelling_2.1138
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: increase in volume of a body when immersed in a liquid or exposed to a vapour.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: synthetic resin_2.1545
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: resin based on a synthetic monomer.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: tack_2.1603
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: property of a material that enables it to form a bond immediately on contact with another surface, which can be adhered or another layer of adhesive.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: tack force_2.1604
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: force necessary to separate an adhesive coat from a second surface shortly after they have been brought into contact under a load equal only to the weight of the adhesively coated article (for example, tape). NOTE The tack force can increase with time as the coat flows.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: tack life_2.1605
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: period of time for which an adhesive coat will be in the tack dry condition (i.e. capable of adhering on contact with another surface, although it seems dry to the touch) after application to a specified adherend under specified conditions of temperature and humidity.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: tackifier_2.1553
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: substance intended to enhance the tack or the tack range of an adhesive coat.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: tactic block_2.1142
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: regular block that can be described by only one species of configurational repeating unit in a single sequential arrangement.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: tactic block polymer_2.1143
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: polymer, the molecules of which consist of tactic blocks connected linearly.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: tactic polymer_2.1144
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: polymer, the molecules of which can be described in terms of only one species of configurational repeating unit in a single sequential arrangement.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: tear_2.1150
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: verb: divide or disrupt by the pulling effect of opposing forces.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: tear propagation force_2.1151
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: force required to continue the growth of a tear initiated in a plastic film.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: tear propagation resistance_2.1152
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: force per unit cross-section force divided by the thickness of the specimen.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: tear resistance_2.1153
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: force required to tear a test specimen of a thin material.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: telomer_2.1154
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: polymer composed of molecules having terminal groups incapable, under the conditions of the synthesis, of reacting with additional monomers to form larger polymer molecules of the same chemical type.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: take-off_2.1146
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: device for conveying extruded or calendered material away from the machine.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: take-up_2.1147
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: device for winding extruded or calendered material.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: terpene resin_2.1567
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: resin consisting essentially of abietic acid and its isomers and obtained from pine trees by the sulfate-cellulose process; used as a tackifier.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: test specimen_2.964
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: piece of material of appropriate shape and size, prepared so that it is ready for use in a test.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: speed of testing_2.1435
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: <tensile testing> rate of separation of the grips of the test machine during the test. NOTE It is expressed in millimetres per minute.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: tension mode_2.1658
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: <testing of adhesives> mode of application of a tensile force normal to the plane of a joint between rigid adherends and uniformly distributed over the whole area of the bond line.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: tensile strength_2.1156
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: <tensile testing> maximum tensile stress sustained by a test specimen during a tensile test. NOTE It is expressed in megapascals.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: tensile stress_2.1436
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: <tensile testing> tensile stress per unit area of the original cross-section of a test specimen within the specimen gauge length at any given moment. NOTE It is expressed in megapascals.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: tensile work to break_2.1287
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: <tensile testing> energy under a plot of the applied stress against the grip displacement, the applied stress being determined from the ratio of the tensile force to the minimum initial cross-sectional area of the specimen. NOTE It is expressed in kilojoules per square metre.

owl:DatatypeProperty.rdfs:label: has tensile work to break value

owl:Class.rdfs:label: tensile-creep modulus_2.1457
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: <tensile-creep testing> ratio of the initial stress to the tensile-creep strain. NOTE It is expressed in megapascals.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: tensile-creep strain_2.1455
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: <tensile-creep testing> change, produced by the applied load, in the distance between the gauge marks on the test specimen relative to the original distance between them. NOTE It is expressed as a dimensionless ratio or as a percentage.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: tensile-impact strength_2.2784
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: energy absorbed in breaking a specimen by a single blow of the pendulum of a tensile-impact testing machine under specified conditions. NOTE The specimen can be notched or unnotched. NOTE 2 Tensile-impact strength is expressed in kilojoules per square metre.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: thermal radiation_2.761
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: transfer of thermal energy by electromagnetic waves.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: thermal stability_2.1166
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: ability of a material to resist degradation under the action of heat.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: thermal-insulation criterion 'I'_2.760
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: criterion, determined from the results of a fire resistance test, by which the ability of a separating element to prevent the passage of heat is assessed.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: thermally foamed plastic_2.1167
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: cellular plastic produced by applying heat to effect gaseous decomposition or volatilization of a constituent.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: thermodilatometry_2.1169
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: technique in which a dimension of a substance under negligible load is measured as a function of temperature or time while the substance is subjected to a controlled temperature programme.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: thermomechanical measurement_2.1170
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: technique in which the deformation of a substance under non-oscillatory load is measured as a function of temperature while the substance is subjected to a controlled temperature programme.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: thermophilic incubation period_2.1870
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: composting of plastics waste: incubation at 58 °C to allow the development of microorganisms growing at high temperature (expressed as time).

owl:Class.rdfs:label: thermoplastic elastomer_2.1179
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: polymer or blend of polymers that has properties at its service temperature similar to those of vulcanized rubber but which can be processed and reprocessed at elevated temperatures like thermoplastics.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: thermoplastic (adjective)_2.1177
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: having the property of being softenable and reprocessable on heating.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: thermoplastic (noun)_2.1181
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: plastic which softens on heating and which can be moulded and remoulded on heating without chemical change.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: thermoset_2.1181
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: plastic which, when cured by heat or other means, changes into a substantially infusible and insoluble product.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: thermosetting plastic_2.1184
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: plastic that has thermosetting properties.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: thermosetting adhesive_2.1183
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: adhesive which is capable of becoming substantially infusible and insoluble product when cured by heat or by other means.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: thicker_2.1186
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: substance that increases the viscosity of a liquid polymeric system.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: thickness_2.187
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: <test specimen> the shorter dimension of the rectangular cross-section perpendicular to the longitudinal direction of a bar (beam) test specimen. NOTE It is expressed in millimetres.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: thiourea-formaldehyde resin_2.1187
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: amino resin made by the polycondensation of thiourea (thiocarbamide) with formaldehyde.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: thixotropy_2.1600
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: degree of apparent viscosity under shear stress, followed by a gradual recovery when the stress is removed.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: time to rupture_2.145
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: <creep testing> period of time during which a specimen is under full load until it ruptures.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: torpedo_2.1189
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: streamlined metal device placed in the path of flow of the plastic material in the heating cylinders of injection-moulding machines and extruders, or in extrusion dies, to spread the melt into thin layers and to enable the material to come into contact with the heating areas.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: total dry solids content_2.1872
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: amount of solids obtained by taking a known volume of test material and drying at about 105 °C to constant mass.

owl:DatatypeProperty.rdfs:label: has total dry solids content value

owl:Class.rdfs:label: total organic carbon TOC_2.1875
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: composting of plastics waste: all the carbon present in the organic matter in the material being composted.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: total spectral transmittance_2.1877
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: ratio of the transmitted radiant flux (regular and diffuse) to the incident radiant flux when a parallel beam of monochromatic radiation of a given wavelength passes through a specimen.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: total luminous transmittance_2.1873
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: ratio of the transmitted luminous flux to the incident luminous flux when a parallel beam of light passes through a specimen.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: toxic hazard_2.763
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: potential for injury or loss of life by exposure to toxicants with respect to their potency, quantity, concentration and duration of exposure.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: toxicity_2.767
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: ability of a substance to produce an adverse effect upon a living organism.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: toxic potency_2.764
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: measure of the amount of toxicant required to elicit a specific toxic effect.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: toxic risk_2.765
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: result of multiplying the probability of occurrence of a toxic hazard to be expected in a given technical operation or state by the consequence or extent of injury to be expected on the occurrence of the toxic hazard.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: toxicant_2.766
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: substance which has an adverse effect upon a living organism.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: tracking resistance_2.768
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: ability of a material to withstand a test voltage, under specified conditions, without creating conducting paths on the surface of the material and without the occurrence of flame.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: transparency_2.1200
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: property of a material by which a negligible portion of the transmitted light undergoes scattering, thereby enabling objects to be distinguished clearly through the material.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: transparent plastic_2.1879
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: plastic in which the transmittance of light is essentially regular and which has a high transmittance in the visible region of the spectrum.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: two-part adhesive_2.1535
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: adhesive that consists of two separate reactive components that are mixed before use.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: transfer tape_2.1528
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: carrier coated with a pressure-sensitive adhesive which, when detached from the substrate, permits the carrier to be removed, leaving only the adhesive.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: turbidity_2.1208
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: apparent absorbance of incident radiation, attributable to scattering.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: two-way-stick adhesive_2.1533
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: adhesive that is applied to both adherends.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: type of failure_2.772
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: <puncture testing> type of deformation behaviour of the material under test.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: type of failure_2.1344
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: <Charpy and Izod impact testing> type of deformation behaviour of the material under test.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: ultrasonic welding_2.1209
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: pressure welding process in which the surfaces to be united are softened by heat produced by intramolecular vibratory motion at ultrasonic frequencies.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: undercure_2.1210
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: state of cure of a polymeric system when curing conditions (e.g. time, temperature, radiation, amounts of curing additives) have been insufficient to produce a satisfactory cure.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: undercut_2.1211
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: depression in the wall of a mould cavity that necessitates deformation of the moulding or the use of special mould construction for ejection.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: unidirectional fabric_2.1212
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: fabric with a great number of yarns or rovings in one direction (usually the warp) and fewer and generally finer yarns in the other direction, resulting in a fabric much stronger in the first direction than in the other.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: unidirectional prepreg_2.1085
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: unidirectional structure, that has been impregnated with a thermosetting or thermoplastic resin system.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: monodisperse polymer_2.1213
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: polymer molecules which are uniform with respect to their relative molecular mass and constitution.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: unsaturated polyester_2.1216
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: polyester characterized by carbon-carbon unsaturation in the polymer chain, which permits subsequent crosslinking with an unsaturated monomer or prepolymer.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: unsupported-film adhesive_2.1525
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: adhesive supplied in sheet, film or web form, without an incorporated carrier.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: untreated fibre_2.1047
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: fibre that has not been subjected to the process of surface treatment.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: upstroke press_2.1217
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: press in which the pressing device is situated below the moving table, pressure being applied by an upward movement of this device.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: urea plastic_2.1219
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: plastic based on amino resins, urea being present in the greatest amount by mass of the amines or amides involved in the polymerization.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: urethane plastic_2.1220
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: plastic based on polymers in which the repeated structural units in the chains are of the urethane type, or on copolymers in which urethane and other types of repeated structural unit are present in the macromolecule.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: vacuum pressing_2.1633
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: application of pressure to an assembly by inserting the assembly into a flexible cover or bag from which the air is then evacuated.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: vacuum thermoforming_2.1222
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: snap-back thermoforming process in which a vacuum is used to form a heated sheet against the mould surface.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: veil_2.442
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: <textile glass> thin layer made from (continuous or chopped) glass filaments held together with a binder.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: veneer_2.1224
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: thin wood sheeting used to make plywood or to serve as a decorative surface layer on a laminate.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: vent_2.1225
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: slot or groove provided in a mould or machine to allow air and gas to escape during moulding, extrusion or forming.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: verification of an instrument_2.1926
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: <durometer hardness> all of the operations carried out in order to ensure compliance of a durometer with the requirements of the test method standard.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: verification of an instrument_2.1483
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: <general> proof, with the use of calibrated standards or standard reference materials, that the calibration of the instrument is accurate.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: very-low density polyethylene PE-LD_2.1375
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: polyethylene which has many short-chain branches, an insignificant number of long-chain branches and a density typically of 0,910 grams/cubic centimetre or less.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: Vicat softening temperature_2.957
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: temperature at which a specified indenter tip with a flat point penetrates 1 mm into a plastic test specimen, when the temperature of the specimen is raised in a specified rate from room temperature Note: It is expressed in degrees Celsius.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: vinyl acetate plastic_2.1227
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: plastic based on polymers of vinyl acetate or copolymers of vinyl acetate with other monomers, the vinyl acetate being in the greatest amount by mass.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: vinyl chloride plastic_2.1228
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: plastic based on polymers of vinyl chloride or copolymers of vinyl chloride with other monomers, the vinyl chloride being in the greatest amount by mass.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: vinyl resin_2.1229
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: resin made by polymerization of monomers containing the vinyl group.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: vinylidene chloride plastic_2.1230
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: plastic based on polymers of vinylidene chloride or copolymers of vinylidene chloride with other monomers, the vinylidene chloride being in the greatest amount by mass.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: vinyl plastisol_2.1231
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: plastic based on polymers of vinyl chloride or copolymers of vinyl chloride with other monomers, in the form of pellets, granules, powder, floc, etc., that has not been subjected to use or processing other than that required for its initial manufacture.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: viscoelasticity_2.1232
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: stress response of a material acting as though it were a combination of an elastic solid and a viscous fluid with flow dependent on time, temperature, load and rate of loading.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: visible fibre_2.1237
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: fibre wetted incompletely with resin and hence appearing at the surface of a reinforced plastic.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: void_2.1238
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: <non-cellular plastics> enclosed cavity of an undefined shape, containing air or some other gas.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: void_2.1239
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: <cellular plastics> cavity formed unintentionally in cellular plastics and substantially larger than the characteristic individual cells.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: volatile-solids content_2.1889
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: amount of solids obtained by subtracting the residue of a known volume of test material or compost after incineration at about 550 °C from the total dry solids of the same test sample.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: volume expansion_2.1240
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: increase in the volume of a specimen under specified test conditions.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: volume resistance_2.1241
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: quotient of the voltage applied between two electrodes which are in contact with, or embedded in, two opposite sides of a specimen by that portion of the current flowing through the volume of the specimen, excluding current flowing along the surface.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: volumetric feeding_2.1243
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: moulding: way of feeding in which the material being fed is controlled volumetrically.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: warp_2.1245
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: dimensional distortion of a plastic object after moulding or other fabrication, caused by non-uniform shrinkage or internal stress.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: waste_2.1710
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: any material or object which the holder discards, or intends to discard, or is required to discard.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: water absorption_2.1246
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: amount of water absorbed by a material under specified test conditions.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: water-borne adhesive_2.1473
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: adhesive in which the solvent, or the continuous phase, is water.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: water-holding capacity_2.1892
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: mass of water which evaporates from a known mass of material saturated with water when the material is dried to constant mass at 105 °C, divided by the dry mass of the material.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: water-resistant_2.1671
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: property of an adhesive able to withstand prolonged contact with water whilst retaining adequate bond strength and other properties necessary for its intended purpose.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: waterproof_2.1671
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: deprecated synonym for water-resistant used in some contexts.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: weight feeding_2.1250
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: <moulding> way of feeding in which the material being fed is controlled gravimetrically.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: weld line_2.1251
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: mark on a moulded plastic formed by the union of two or more streams of plastic flowing together; also known as knit line or weld mark.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: welding_2.1252
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: process of uniting softened surfaces of materials, generally with the aid of heat.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: wet bonding_2.1626
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: adhesives where the adhesive coats applied still contain substantial amounts of volatile adhesive constituents when the coats are brought together; also referred to as "wet-stick" adhesives.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: wet strength_2.1253
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: <adhesives> strength of an adhesive joint determined immediately after removal from a liquid in which it has been immersed under specified conditions of time, temperature and composition.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: wettability_2.1607
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: extent to which a liquid wets a solid surface as expressed by the contact angle between the liquid and the solid surface.

owl:Class.rdfs:label: white point temperature_2.1255
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: <dispersion> limiting temperature below which an opaque mass, and above which a transparent film, is formed.
